text: The lab results show an unconjugated hyperbilirubinemia, which makes biliary atresia unlikely despite the family history. Since the infant is thriving and exclusively breastfed, this presentation is classic for breast milk jaundice. DIAGNOSIS READY: Breast milk jaundice
